text.p: Results of English Sunday League matches:
At Colwyn Bay: Nottinghamshire beat Glamorgan by 20 runs. Nottinghamshire 228-8 innings closed (M.Dowman 71, N.Astle 63), Glamorgan 208 (A.Oram 4-45).
Colchester: Leicestershire beat Essex by 35 runs. Leicestershire 225-9 innings closed (D.Maddy 75), Essex 190 (D.Maddy 3-17)
Chester-le-Street: Durham beat Derbyshire by 5 wickets. Derbyshire 181-9 innings closed, Durham 185-5.
Edgbaston (Birmingham): Warwickshire beat Sussex on a faster scoring rate. Sussex 162-9 innings closed, Warwickshire 102-3
Worcester: Worcestershire v Kent - match abandoned with Worcestershire 117-3 off 24 overs.
Headingley (Leeds): Yorkshire beat Northamptonshire by 38 runs. Yorkshire 239-9 innings closed (A.McGrath 63, C.White 57), Northamptonshire 2-1 (K.Curran 57)
Lord's: Surrey v Middlesex - match abandoned with Surrey 74-7.
